source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Mystique (archived 29 June 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: Born a mutant with total control over the cells of her body, letting her take on the look of almost anyone.

abilities.name: Shapeshifting
abilities.detail: Instantly reshapes her cells to look and sound like nearly any humanoid, copying retinas, fingerprints, scent, heat signature and voice prints.

abilities.name: Metamorphic adaptation
abilities.detail: Can camouflage herself to near invisibility, mimic glass or metal textures, grow tentacles, take animal shapes and hide items inside her body.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.detail: Repairs wounds, regrows limbs and recovers from near-fatal injuries far faster than a normal human.

abilities.name: Slowed ageing and resistances
abilities.detail: Over a century old yet still in her prime, with fast-building immunity to toxins and disease and a natural shield against telepaths.

abilities.name: Master martial artist
abilities.detail: A highly skilled fighter whose hand-to-hand ability the wiki ranks alongside Black Widow and Captain America.

abilities.name: Marksman and covert operative
abilities.detail: An expert shot, trained actress and strategist of terrorist and commando operations.

abilities.name: Multilingual
abilities.detail: Knows at least eleven languages, among them German, English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Farsi, Japanese, Korean, Swedish and Czech.

feats.text: Led her new Brotherhood of Mutants in an attempt to assassinate Senator Robert Kelly, a plot the X-Men stopped with help from a time-travelling Kate Pryde.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Uncanny X-Men Vol 1 142

feats.text: With Sabretooth and Toad, raided Damage Control and stole files on Nimrod and the Mother Mold for Xavier, escaping with the data.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: House of X Vol 1 1

feats.text: With her powers boosted by Fabian Cortez, copied the powers of Magneto, Juggernaut, Cable and Marrow.
At Liberty Island she fought Wolverine, then posed as Storm; stabbed by him, she survived and slipped past police disguised as a fallen officer.
Posing as Stryker's aide she copied his files, then drugged a prison guard and injected him with liquid iron, which Magneto used to escape.
Entered Stryker's Alkali Lake base disguised as Wolverine, dodged the guards' fire, beat them and took the control room to open the gates.
